login.tagline: Virtual funds · live market data. Stocks, crypto and perpetual futures, plus an AI trader that trades on its own and an analysis chat you can ask anything — find out what if you had bought, at zero risk.

reset.title: Reset account
reset.desc: Clears all positions, orders, game records and asset history and restores your balance to the starting capital. Comments and mute status are unaffected. One reset per calendar week, refreshed on Monday.
reset.warnClears: This cannot be undone. It clears: all spot and futures positions and orders, prediction bets, Blackjack / Mines / Video Poker records, asset history, daily buffs and wallet transfers.
reset.warnCost: One reset per calendar week, refreshed on Monday. An automatic bankruptcy recovery counts toward the same quota.
reset.done: Account reset to its initial state

toggle.title: Make my holdings and position history public
toggle.desc: When on, anyone can open your profile from the leaderboard and see your current holdings, futures position history and trades. Turning it off does not affect the leaderboard — that only shows total assets and return.
toggle.on: Your holdings and position history are now public
toggle.off: Hidden — others can no longer open your profile

profile.private: This user's holdings and position history are private
profile.tradingProfitHint: Net PnL from futures, spot and prediction, coupons excluded
profile.emptyHistory: This user has no closed futures positions

rate.title: Daily margin interest rate
rate.hint: The input is a percentage; 0.05%/day is decimal=0.0005.

invite.title: Invite codes
invite.badArgs: Uses and quantity must both be positive integers

llm.title: LLM configuration
llm.hint: One entry = one LLM (API Key + Base URL + model name); the same key with a different model needs its own entry.
llm.protoChat: Protocol: OpenAI Chat Completions (/v1/chat/completions, for DeepSeek and most others)
llm.protoResponses: Protocol: OpenAI Responses (/v1/responses, CPA / OpenAI / xAI)
llm.effortPh: Reasoning effort, blank = model default (not sent)
llm.effortHint: none turns reasoning off and uses the fewest tokens (only some models support it); you can also enter any other level the model accepts, such as xhigh. No way to check up front — save it and try.
llm.required: Name, API Key, Base URL and Model are all required

assign.title: Switch LLM
assign.hint: Pick the LLM for each slot; it applies as soon as you save. Model names live under LLM configuration above.
